The *Kāmāvacaraduka* is a canonical Abhidhamma text belonging to the *Paṭṭhāna*, the seventh treatise of the Pali Abhidhamma Piṭaka. In keeping with the structural methodology of the *Paṭṭhāna*, this unit examines the conditional causal relations (*paccaya*) operating within the framework of the dyad (*duka*) concerning phenomena pertaining to the realm of sense experience (*kāmāvacara*).

 Within the Pali canon, DharmaNexus records extensive text reuse internal to the *Paṭṭhāna* collection, identifying 97 matching passages across 32 Pali texts [DharmaNexus].
